title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server Pre-Acceptance Ingress Policy Work Item
summary: Close the bounded RFC 9000 Section 5.2.2 server pre-acceptance ingress policy floor without widening into connection-refusal or 0-RTT buffering behavior.
planned_changes:
- Add a small listener pre-acceptance classifier for unmatched datagrams.
- Add Version Negotiation limiting support while preserving unlimited default listener behavior.
- Require zero-length connection-ID routes to match the registered local address and port when local tuple data is available.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for unsupported-version drop/response behavior, response limiting, supported-version and zero-length-CID matching, conforming Initial admission, premature Handshake drops, and unmatched short-header drops.
- Link the focused proof to dedicated architecture and verification artifacts.
verification_plan: Run the focused S5P2P2 requirement-home filter, run a Release build, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: 0-RTT buffering before a matching Initial arrives.
Client-side Version Negotiation processing or Initial/Retry connection-ID continuity.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused server pre-acceptance ingress slice over QuicListenerHost, QuicListenerPreAcceptanceIngressPolicy, QuicVersionNegotiation, and QuicConnectionRuntimeEndpoint.
